description:
HORZONYX is a team of four passionate young innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Driven by creativity, technology, and curiosity, we aim to build an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that inspires young minds to explore space, experience astronaut training, and understand the wonders of space missions. We believe innovation has no boundaries and the future belongs to curious explorers.

HORZONYX – Beyond Imagination. Towards Infinity.
